excerpt: Learn how AWS Professional Services uses a multi-agent framework built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to automate enterprise cloud migrations end to end. Purpose-built AI agents handle discovery, infrastructure as code generation, portfolio governance, and post-migration operations, reducing IaC development time from weeks to minutes.
